request: what's the chance of guessing which of three cups hides the ball?

beats.intent: Three cups as upside-down trapezoids in a row
beats.narration: Three cups on a table; a ball is hidden under one of them.
beats.code:
stage.title("Find the ball")
cup = lambda x: Polygon([x - 0.6, -1, 0], [x + 0.6, -1, 0], [x + 0.4, 0.4, 0], [x - 0.4, 0.4, 0], color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.8)
cups = VGroup(*[cup(x) for x in (-3, 0, 3)])
stage.play(FadeIn(cups))
stage.add(cups)

beats.intent: The middle cup lifting to show a yellow ball underneath
beats.narration: Lift a cup: here the ball was under the middle one.
beats.code:
ball = Dot(np.array([0, -0.75, 0]), radius=0.22, color=YELLOW)
self.add(ball)
self.bring_to_back(ball)
stage.play(cups[1].animate.shift(UP * 1.5))

beats.intent: Bars of 1/3 for each cup beside P = 1/3
beats.narration: Each cup is equally likely, so a guess is right one time in three.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
bars = draw_bars(stage, [1, 1, 1], labels=["left", "middle", "right"])
stage.equation(r"P(\text{right guess}) = \tfrac13")

request: what's the chance of picking a red marble from a bag of 3 red and 2 blue?

beats.intent: A bag drawn as a circle holding 3 red and 2 blue dots
beats.narration: A bag holds three red marbles and two blue.
beats.code:
stage.title("Marbles in a bag")
bag = Circle(radius=1.6, color=GREY_B)
marbles = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.25, color=c) for c in (RED, RED, RED, BLUE, BLUE)]).arrange_in_grid(2, 3, buff=0.3)
stage.play(Create(bag), FadeIn(marbles))
stage.add(bag, marbles)

beats.intent: One red marble pulled out of the bag to the right
beats.narration: Reach in and pull one out without looking.
beats.code: stage.play(marbles[0].animate.move_to(RIGHT * 3.5), run_time=1)

beats.intent: The bag beside P(red) = 3/5
beats.narration: Three of the five are red, so the chance of red is three fifths.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"P(\text{red}) = \frac{3}{5}")

request: how many games are there in a knockout tournament of 8 teams?

beats.intent: Eight team dots on the left paired into 4 matches
beats.narration: Eight teams, paired off into four matches.
beats.code:
stage.title("A knockout tournament")
nodes = {f"T{k}": (-0.9, 0.85 - 0.24 * k) for k in range(8)}
nodes.update({f"Q{k}": (-0.3, 0.73 - 0.48 * k) for k in range(4)})
edges = [(f"T{2 * k + i}", f"Q{k}") for k in range(4) for i in range(2)]
dots, lines = draw_network(stage, nodes, edges)

beats.intent: Winners joined into 2 semi-finals and 1 final
beats.narration: Four winners play two semi-finals, and the two winners play the final.

beats.intent: The bracket beside 4 + 2 + 1 = 7 games, one per losing team
beats.narration: Four plus two plus one is seven games. Quicker: every game knocks out one team, and seven must lose.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"4 + 2 + 1 = 7 = 8 - 1")

request: how many ways can 4 people sit around a round table?

beats.intent: A round table with four people A, B, C, D as dots around it
beats.narration: Four people around a round table.
beats.code:
stage.title("A round table")
table = draw_circle(stage, radius=1.2)
names = "ABCD"
ppl = VGroup(*[Dot(1.9 * np.array([np.cos(TAU * k / 4), np.sin(TAU * k / 4), 0]), radius=0.2, color=[RED, GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW][k]) for k in range(4)])
stage.play(FadeIn(ppl))
stage.add(ppl)
for k, d in enumerate(ppl):
    stage.label(d, names[k], direction=UP)

beats.intent: Everyone moving one seat round, the same arrangement
beats.narration: Everyone moves one seat round: nobody's neighbours changed, so it is the same seating.
beats.code:
stage.play(Rotate(ppl, TAU / 4, about_point=ORIGIN), run_time=1.5)
stage.caption("Rotating does not make a new seating")

beats.intent: The table beside 4!/4 = 3! = 6
beats.narration: The twenty four orders come in groups of four rotations, so there are six different seatings.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"\frac{4!}{4} = 3! = 6")

request: if today is Monday, what day is it in 10 days?

beats.intent: Seven boxes in a row labelled Mon to Sun with Monday lit
beats.narration: A week is seven days. Today is Monday.
beats.code:
stage.title("Counting days")
days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
boxes = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.9, color=BLUE) for _ in days]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
stage.play(Create(boxes))
stage.add(boxes)
for b, d in zip(boxes, days):
    stage.play(FadeIn(Text(d, font_size=22).move_to(b)), run_time=0.15)
highlight(stage, boxes[0], color=GREEN)

beats.intent: An arrow looping once round all seven days and on three more to Thursday
beats.narration: Ten days on: seven brings you back to Monday, then three more.
beats.code:
loop = CurvedArrow(boxes[0].get_top() + UP * 0.1, boxes[6].get_top() + UP * 0.1, angle=-PI / 3, color=YELLOW)
more = CurvedArrow(boxes[0].get_bottom() + DOWN * 0.1, boxes[3].get_bottom() + DOWN * 0.1, angle=PI / 3, color=RED)
stage.play(Create(loop))
stage.play(Create(more))
stage.add(loop, more)

beats.intent: Thursday lit beside 10 = 7 + 3, 10 mod 7 = 3
beats.narration: Ten leaves a remainder of three after sevens, so it is three days after Monday: Thursday.
beats.code:
highlight(stage, boxes[3], color=RED)
stage.caption("10 = 7 + 3: Thursday")

request: how many outfits can you make from 3 shirts and 2 pairs of trousers?

beats.intent: Three shirt rectangles in red, green and blue, and two trouser rectangles in grey and black
beats.narration: Three shirts and two pairs of trousers.
beats.code:
stage.title("Counting outfits")
shirts = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=0.8, height=0.6, color=c, fill_opacity=0.8) for c in (RED, GREEN, BLUE)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.6).shift(UP * 1.8)
trousers = VGroup(*[Rectangle(width=0.5, height=0.9, color=c, fill_opacity=0.8) for c in (GREY, DARK_BROWN)]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.4).shift(LEFT * 4.5 + DOWN * 0.3)
stage.play(FadeIn(shirts), FadeIn(trousers))
stage.add(shirts, trousers)

beats.intent: A 2 by 3 grid of outfits, each cell a shirt on top of trousers
beats.narration: Every shirt goes with every pair: a grid of combinations.
beats.code:
cells = VGroup()
for i, t in enumerate(trousers):
    for j, s in enumerate(shirts):
        outfit = VGroup(s.copy().scale(0.8), t.copy().scale(0.8)).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.05)
        outfit.move_to(np.array([s.get_x(), t.get_y(), 0]))
        cells.add(outfit)
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c) for c in cells], lag_ratio=0.15))
stage.add(cells)

beats.intent: The grid beside 3 × 2 = 6 outfits
beats.narration: Three shirts times two trousers: six outfits.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"3 \times 2 = 6")

request: does each person get more pizza with 3 people or 4?

beats.intent: A pizza cut into 3 equal slices, one slice lit
beats.narration: Share a pizza between three: each gets a third.
beats.code:
stage.title("Sharing a pizza")
three = VGroup(*[Sector(radius=1.5, angle=TAU / 3, start_angle=TAU * k / 3, color=ORANGE if k else YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_color=WHITE, stroke_width=3) for k in range(3)]).shift(LEFT * 3)
stage.play(FadeIn(three))
stage.add(three)
stage.label(three, "1/3 each", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: A second pizza cut into 4 slices beside it, one slice lit
beats.narration: Share an equal pizza between four: each gets a quarter.
beats.code:
four = VGroup(*[Sector(radius=1.5, angle=TAU / 4, start_angle=TAU * k / 4, color=ORANGE if k else YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8, stroke_color=WHITE, stroke_width=3) for k in range(4)]).shift(RIGHT * 3)
stage.play(FadeIn(four))
stage.add(four)
stage.label(four, "1/4 each", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: The two lit slices side by side, the third bigger than the quarter
beats.narration: Put the two slices side by side: a third is bigger than a quarter. More people, smaller slices.
beats.code:
a, b = three[0].copy(), four[0].copy()
stage.play(a.animate.move_to(DOWN * 2.3 + LEFT * 0.9), b.animate.move_to(DOWN * 2.3 + RIGHT * 0.9), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(a, b)
stage.caption("1/3 > 1/4")

request: how many cannonballs are in a triangular pyramid with 4 layers?

beats.intent: Four triangles of dots side by side with 1, 3, 6 and 10 dots
beats.narration: Stack cannonballs in triangular layers: one, three, six and ten.

beats.intent: The layers beside 1 + 3 + 6 + 10 = 20
beats.narration: Add the layers: twenty cannonballs.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"1 + 3 + 6 + 10 = 20")

request: how many small cubes make a 3 by 2 by 2 box?

beats.intent: One layer of 3 by 2 squares
beats.narration: The bottom layer of the box is three by two: six cubes.
beats.code:
stage.title("Volume by counting cubes")
layer = lambda c, dx, dy: VGroup(*[Square(side_length=0.6, color=c, fill_opacity=0.6).move_to(np.array([dx + i * 0.6, dy + j * 0.6, 0])) for i in range(3) for j in range(2)])
bottom = layer(BLUE, -2.5, -1)
stage.play(FadeIn(bottom))
stage.add(bottom)
stage.label(bottom, "6 cubes", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: A second identical layer drawn offset up and right, as if stacked on top
beats.narration: Stack a second layer of six on top.
beats.code:
top = layer(GREEN, -2.2, -0.7)
stage.play(FadeIn(top))
stage.add(top)

beats.intent: The two layers beside 3 × 2 × 2 = 12
beats.narration: Two layers of six: twelve cubes. Length times width times height.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"3 \times 2 \times 2 = 12")
